title: .sl/ledger.jsonl (one line)
description: One line of the answer ledger, appended by sl reply (kind reply: the owner's answer to an item of a readback), sl question resolve (kind question: the owner's answer to an open question) or sl review apply (either kind, from a filled review form). It holds the owner's words, never data values.

id.description: ans_ and at least four digits, one more than the line before: ans_0001, ans_0002, ...

kind.description: reply: an answer to a readback item; question: an answer to an open question.

readback_id.description: kind reply: the readback in .sl/pending/ the owner answered.

item.description: kind reply: the item number in that readback.

target.description: kind reply: the item's approve target (golden:<name> for a golden); kind question: the ref the question was resolved on (source.model, source.model.field or access, and from sl review apply also access.roles.<role>).

content_hash.description: kind reply: the target's content hash stored in the readback item when it was read back.

question.description: kind question: the open question as the file held it.

text.description: The owner's words, with credentials redacted and control characters removed.

verdict.description: kind reply: yes, no or change, or null when the words were recorded without one.

at.description: When the answer was recorded, as an ISO timestamp from the command's clock.
